text:
irene: Customer reports their integration started failing when we switched model variant. Using JSON mode \"strict\" their parser errors with: \"invalid type for field 'item_count' - expected number, got \"\"\". Also seeing inconsistent casing for status (\"Complete\" vs \"COMPLETE\").

support: Can you paste an example of the response body and any request IDs?

irene: Example response (copied from customer logs):
```
{
  \"order_id\": 4852,
  \"item_count\": \"\",
  \"status\": \"Complete\",
  \"paid\": null
}
```

support: Ah — item_count is an empty string. In strict JSON mode our schema validator rejects that (expected number). Were these responses streamed?

irene: Yes, they use streaming. Customer repro curl: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{\"model\":\"rw-infer-1\",\"json_mode\":\"strict\",\"stream\":true,\"input\":\"Return JSON for Order.create with fields order_id (int), item_count (optional int), status (enum), paid (bool|null)\"}'
```
They see intermittent failures — about 1 in 60 streamed responses.

sam-dev: Noted. Suspect a streaming/chunk-boundary tokenizer artifact: if numeric token gets split, model could emit nothing for that slot, yielding \"\". Can you share request ids?

irene: Request ids: req_abc123, req_def456, req_ghi789. last_message_ts for the customer session: 1719802061.

mike-ml: We had a small rollout of rw-infer-1 v2.3 yesterday that included tokenizer tweaks and tokenization caching changes. This smells like a streaming + tokenizer + batching corner case. Repro locally with very small chunk sizes should surface it.

support: Customer hit automatic retry logic and produced a billing spike (3x requests). Any immediate mitigation suggestions?

billing-bot: Billing alert: stripe cus_123 incurred +$420.60 from retries. Manual refund flagged; see billing ticket BT-789.

sam-dev: Short-term mitigations: 1) set json_mode to \"lenient\" server-side for this customer, 2) server-side post-processor to coerce empty-string -> null/omit/try-cast for schema-number fields, 3) pin affected customers to rw-infer-1 v2.2 until patch lands.

deploy-bot: Can confirm canary pin rolled: canary-2026-03-17-17 pinned rw-infer-1 -> v2.2 for 3 customers including cus_123.

mike-ml: Long-term: patch tokenizer-streaming edge-case and add unit tests for numeric token boundaries. Also add enum normalization option (case-insensitive enum matching or configurable canonicalizer) to avoid \"Complete\" vs \"COMPLETE\" flips. PR opened: github.com/redwood/serving/pull/451 (post-processor) and github.com/redwood/modeling/pull/452 (tokenizer fix).

irene: Customer accepted temporary lenient mode + refund prep. They will test tomorrow and report. Filing internal escalation ESC-2026-128.

support: Thanks all — marking as monitored. If errors reappear, we escalate back to SEV. :thumbsup:
